title: Obama joins Josh Turek on basketball court to back US Senate bid
shortDescription: Former President Barack Obama endorsed Iowa Democrat Josh Turek for US Senate in a basketball court cameo, boosting his bid for an open GOP-held seat.

title: Fauci pleads the Fifth in Senate hearing on COVID. See key moments
shortDescription: Anthony Fauci, former director at the National Institutes of Health, testifies about the COVID-19 pandemic in front of the Senate. See key moments.

title: Senate confirms Jay Clayton to lead nation's intelligence agencies
shortDescription: Clayton was confirmed by a 51-47 party-line vote after months of turmoil around the Office of Director of National Intelligence.

title: Trump approval falls to new poll low
shortDescription: Donald Trump’s approval rating has fallen to a new low in the latest Economist/YouGov poll.

title: US Sen. Fetterman campaigned to end filibuster. Now he backs it
shortDescription: U.S. Sen. John Fetterman said in a Washington Post column that he was "horribly wrong" about trying to eliminate the filibuster.

title: Michigan Senate hopefuls clash over campaign spending and Gaza war
shortDescription: Michigan Democratic U.S. Senate candidates Haley Stevens and Abdul El-Sayed traded attacks over campaign spending and support for Israel during a debate.

title: Fetterman backs filibuster, flips on campaign promise to eliminate it
shortDescription: U.S. Sen. John Fetterman promised during his 2022 campaign to work to eliminate the filibuster. Now, he said he sees the filibuster as necessary.

title: South Dakota primary runoff results: Who won GOP governor race?
shortDescription: Incumbent Gov. Larry Rhoden holds off challenger Toby Doeden.

title: In Trump era, Canadians must enter border library through back door
shortDescription: The new backdoor entrance at this historic library on the U.S.-Canada border shows how Trump is redefining America's relationship with its neighbor.

title: Trump wants a stronger northern border. The view from the Canadian side.
shortDescription: Exclusive: How the Canadians view Trump's push for a tough border.

title: Can Democrats salvage a once-hopeful Senate race, now mired in scandal?
shortDescription: Platner fans are hurt, disappointed. Some are unenrolling from the Democratic Party. But most seem to still be united around his movement.

title: Activists defend century-old tree standing in way of Trump’s border wall
shortDescription: The tree is the last remaining of four cottonwoods that have stood along the U.S.-Mexico border in Lochiel, Arizona, for between an estimated 100 to 200 years. Border Patrol says the trees must be removed for the wall.

title: Senate greenlights Russia sanctions bill in Lindsey Graham's honor
shortDescription: The Ukrainian president watched in the Senate chamber as lawmakers cast their votes.

title: Trump asks Supreme Court to throw out $83M award to E. Jean Carroll
shortDescription: Donald Trump is asking the Supreme Court to overturn the $83.3 million defamation award owed to E. Jean Carroll.

title: Democrats seek answers on Trump plan to send federal agents to polls
shortDescription: In a letter, Senate Democrats press the Trump administration to disclose any plans to send federal agents or National Guard members to polling places.

title: Who's running to replace late Sen. Lindsey Graham in Senate primary
shortDescription: The candidate filing period in a special primary to fill Lindsey Graham's seat is now closed, and a dozen candidates will face off for the Republican nomination.

title: Biden audio raises document questions

title: GOP memo urges senators to say 'we don't have the votes' for SAVE Act
shortDescription: A strategy document circulated this week advises GOP senators' offices to walk a fine line on Trump's favored voting restrictions bill.

title: Trump says he'll honor teenage lifeguard who saved boy in Santa Cruz
shortDescription: Trump says he'll honor the "heroic" 16-year-old life guard who saved a boy after he became engulfed in rough seas in Santa Cruz, California.

title: Judge says Trump group with only Christians, Jews is fairly balanced
shortDescription: The federal judge, whom Trump appointed in 2020, said commissioners reflected a variety of sectors, life experiences and religious beliefs.

title: Trump holds back-to-back meetings with Netanyahu, Zelenskyy: See photos
shortDescription: President Donald Trump hosts Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy at the White House for separate high-stakes meetings.

title: Trump praises Lindsey Graham in eulogy
shortDescription: President Trump honored Lindsey Graham in a heartfelt eulogy, reflecting on his political legacy.

title: Biden kept classified documents, he says in newly released interviews
shortDescription: An offshoot of the Heritage Foundation released interviews in which Joe Biden tells the ghostwriter for his memoir that he had classified information.

title: New poll finds Trump approval ratings underwater
shortDescription: Trump hit his lowest approval rating since returning to office, according to a new poll that found 62% of Americans disapprove.
